text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert -> P1: canary error-rate breach on runway-prod (10m window). Auto-created channel and paged on-call.

Sam (oncall): I'm on it. Paging eng-sre + releases. @Priya @Marta can you triage? Any idea if this is from the deploy 01:05Z? :alarm_clock:

Marta (releases): yep that deploy. Roll 2026-03-15T01:05Z by marta. Commit abcdef1 pushed tokenizer init refactor. Canary 10% -> 100% started at 01:08Z. Deploy Bot shows canary errors spiking after 01:10Z.

Priya (eng-sre): on logs now. Seeing repeated 503s from tokenizer pods, OOMs + init failures. Stack indicates new init path hitting a race on large inputs.

Sam (oncall): what's the blast radius?

Priya (eng-sre): currently only canary pool and small fraction of host traffic. But proxy dropped requests propagated to customers C-123/C-451/C-789 numbers showing elevated errors.

Marta (releases): we should stop traffic ASAP. Two options: flip feature flag or revert single commit hotfix. Flip is faster. Flag name: feature/tokenizer_v2_enable (scoped to runway-prod).

Sam (oncall): flip first, then coordinate revert if needed. I'll flip and monitor.

Marta (releases): command to kill flag (run this):

```
ffctl set runway-prod feature/tokenizer_v2_enable false --actor=marta --reason="canary error spike"
```

Sam (oncall): executing now.

Sam (oncall): Done. `ffctl` returned 200. Feature flag set to false at 2026-03-15T01:19Z. :white_check_mark:

Deploy Bot: feature/tokenizer_v2_enable=false applied to runway-prod at 2026-03-15T01:19Z (operator: Sam).

Priya (eng-sre): error-rate dropping but still seeing tail errors from pods in crash loop. Flag prevented new traffic hitting the code path, but some canary pods need replacement.

Marta (releases): agree. We should prepare a single-commit revert and push a hotfix canary. Small revert is safer than patching the change in-place under duress.

Priya (eng-sre): I'll do revert and open hotfix branch. Reverting commit abcdef1. Steps:

```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b hotfix/revert-tokenizer origin/main
git revert --no-edit abcdef1
git push origin hotfix/revert-tokenizer
# open PR -> CI -> merge -> deploy
```

Priya (eng-sre): CI green locally. Requesting canary deploy at 5%. @Deploy Bot can you kick it?

Deploy Bot: Canary deploy triggered for branch hotfix/revert-tokenizer -> canary=5% at 2026-03-15T01:29Z (initiated by Priya).

Marta (releases): watching rollout. Will keep the flag false until we confirm stability.

Priya (eng-sre): canary tokens showing steady state. No OOMs, init path back to previous behavior. Error-rate back to baseline ~0.2% for 10m.

Sam (oncall): great. Rolling out to 100% now?

Marta (releases): let's do a progressive ramp: 5 -> 25 -> 60 -> 100 with 5m checks. I'll do 25 now.

Deploy Bot: Ramp to 25% at 2026-03-15T01:36Z.

Priya (eng-sre): metrics look clean. 60% at 01:42Z.

Deploy Bot: Ramp to 60% at 2026-03-15T01:42Z, 100% at 2026-03-15T01:48Z.

Priya (eng-sre): Post-rollout signals stable. Turning off replacement patch monitors.

Sam (oncall): Handing on-call to Priya for the rest of the night — Priya, please own monitoring and the incident ticket. I'll update the incident page and notify CS. :handshake:

Priya (eng-sre): taking it. Will keep an eye for another 2 hours.

Jorge (cust-succ): CS update: three customers had elevated errors/timeouts during 01:05Z-01:25Z. I'm drafting a note. Proposed text: "We briefly experienced degraded tokenizer responses between 01:05 and 01:25 UTC after a canary deploy. We reverted the change and traffic is restored. If you saw errors, please reach out to support@redwood.com. Apologies for the disruption." Please flag if anything else.

Marta (releases): sounds good. Add: we rolled back a single commit (abcdef1) and applied a hotfix; no data loss.

Jorge (cust-succ): added that. Sending targeted messages to affected accounts now.

Priya (eng-sre): quick root-cause notes for incident: tokenizer init refactor introduced a race when processing very large input arrays -> memory allocations spike -> OOM on some nodes -> 503s. Triggered during canary ramp.

Sam (oncall): next steps/action items: 
- Priya: follow-up postmortem with timeline + repro steps + permanent fix plan
- Marta: add a canary guardrail to block ramp if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m + memory pressure check
- Eng: add regression test for large inputs on tokenizer init path
- Releases: require FF gate for tokenizer_v2 rollout until mem tests exist

Priya (eng-sre): noted. Will own postmortem and assign tasks.

Marta (releases): retrospective: revert was clean; flipping flag bought us time — flag-to-revert flow worked as intended. We'll add automation to suggest flag flip on similar sensor patterns. :memo:

Sam (oncall): closing incident channel once Priya confirms metrics for 2 hours. Great job team. :trophy:

Deploy Bot: Incident closed (monitoring phase) at 2026-03-15T02:10Z.

Priya (eng-sre): metrics stable for 90 minutes, handover complete. I'll file the postmortem and link to this channel.

Jorge (cust-succ): customers notified, no escalations so far.

Marta (releases): adding follow-up ticket for guardrail + FF gating.

Sam (oncall): thanks all. :rocket:
